About Us:

We are a fast-growing licensed life insurance agency looking for a dependable and proactive Policy Coordinator to join our team full-time.



We are ideally looking for someone with previous experience working in the insurance industry for US-based agencies or insurance companies.

• Someone who takes initiative and solves problems independently

• Customer service or administrative experience preferred

• Life insurance industry experience in the US is preferred

• Experience working with US-based insurance agencies or companies is highly preferred

• Experience using CRMs, Google workspace, or insurance platforms is a plus

• Reliable computer, headset, and stable internet connection required



WHAT WE OFFER



• Full-time remote position

• Long-term growth opportunity

• Supportive and fast-growing team environment

• Performance-based increases available

• Training and systems provided



HOW TO APPLY



Please
 the following to:





Include:

1. Your resume

2. A short introduction about yourself

3. Your relevant insurance experience

4. Your internet speed and computer setup

5. Your availability and timezone

6. A short video answering the questions below



VIDEO QUESTIONS



1. Share your relevant experience working in insurance. What products did you help clients with?

2. What is an example of how you helped move a policy forward for a client?

3. Why would you be a good fit for this role?



We are looking to hire immediately for the right candidate.

description:
JOB SUMMARY:

We are looking for a dependable, compassionate, and detail-oriented Home Care Intake

Coordinator to serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients, families, referral

sources, and caregivers for our US-based home care operations. This role is responsible for

managing new client inquiries, gathering and documenting intake information, coordinating

admissions, providing exceptional customer service, and supporting care coordination to ensure

a seamless onboarding experience. The Intake Coordinator also assists with administrative

tasks and maintains accurate records while ensuring confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA

standards.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Serve as the first point of contact for new client inquiries via phone and other

communication channels

- Explain home care services, care options, pricing, and the intake process to prospective

clients and families

- Gather, verify, and document client demographic information, care needs, medical

history, and other required intake details

- Conduct initial intake assessments and pre-qualify prospective clients based on service

needs

- Coordinate new client admissions with Care Coordinators and the clinical team

- Maintain accurate client records and ensure all intake documentation is complete and

entered into the agency's software system

- Accurately transfer calls to the appropriate department or staff member

- Document all call activity, referrals, client inquiries, and follow-up actions

- Communicate effectively with clients, family members, caregivers, referral sources, and

office staff

- Monitor pending intakes and follow up on outstanding documentation to ensure timely

admissions

- Support Care Coordinators with client onboarding and caregiver coordination for new

cases

- Assist with scheduling adjustments when necessary to support new client starts

- Prepare intake, referral, and admissions reports as requested

- Escalate urgent client concerns or potential clinical issues to the appropriate supervisor

- Perform general administrative and office support duties as assigned

- Maintain confidentiality and comply with HIPAA guidelines at all times



WORK SCHEDULE / SHIFT AVAILABILITY:

- Must be open to potential on-call shifts as operational needs evolve.



QUALIFICATIONS (Preferred):

- High school diploma or GED required

- Nursing experience is highly preferred

- Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in home care, healthcare, medical office, patient

intake, or client services

- Previous experience as an Intake Coordinator, Patient Coordinator, Medical

- Receptionist, or similar healthcare role preferred

- Strong understanding of home care services, levels of care, and private pay services

- Ability to identify potential clinical concerns and escalate appropriately

- Excellent customer service, phone etiquette, and interpersonal communication skills

- Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills

- High attention to detail and accuracy in documentation

- Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment

- Experience using healthcare databases, CRM, EMR, or scheduling software

- WellSky CRM experience is a plus

- Knowledge of HIPAA and patient privacy standards

- Proficient in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS (Important):

- Attach your updated resume.

- Subject line must be formatted exactly as: Last Name, First Name – Home Care Intake

Coordinator

- Only 10 application points will be accepted.

- Applications that do not follow these instructions will be disregarded.

title: Operations & Executive Assistant (Remote – Long-Term)
description:
This is not a typical assistant role.



We are building a company where AI handles the routine work, and our people handle the thinking. If you are someone who already works that way — or wants to — this role was built for you.



We are looking for an Operations & Executive Assistant who is as comfortable setting up an AI workflow as they are managing a client invoice or reconciling a vendor bill. Someone who sees a repetitive task and immediately thinks "how do I automate this" rather than "I'll just do it manually every time."



If that is how your mind works, keep reading.



~~~~~~~~~~

~About Us~

We are a Canadian Managed IT Services company supporting 225 devices across 15 business clients. We are growing fast and hiring an Operations, Accounting & Executive Assistant to help remove bottlenecks so our founder can focus on scaling the business from 225 to 500+ endpoints.



The person in this role will not just help us operate — they will help us build systems that let us scale without adding headcount at every step.



~~~~~~~~~~

~Your Mission~

Keep our operations and customers organized, our accounting accurate, our clients well-billed, and our vendor invoices reconciled — while continuously finding smarter, AI-powered ways to get more done with less manual effort.



~~~~~~~~~~

~Work Schedule~

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Flexible schedule with a minimum 4-hour overlap with Pacific Time (Canada)

- You choose your remaining hours within reason



~~~~~~~~~~

~Compensation~

- CAD $600 – $1,200/month depending on experience

- Paid bi-weekly

- End-of-year performance bonus tied to company growth and your contribution to it — the more you help the business grow, the more you share in that success

- Long-term role with a clear path to increased responsibility and pay



~~~~~~~~~~

~Primary Responsibilities~



~Founder Support~

- Manage and organize
 inbox

- Respond to simple client inquiries

- Schedule meetings and follow-ups

- Track action items and tasks

- Prepare weekly operations summaries



~Client Operations~

- Track client users, devices, and licenses for invoicing

- Maintain client records and documentation

- Assist with quoting clients, sourcing prices, Liason with founder and build quote, move quote to order and invoice appropriately and assist on collecting payment



~~~~~~~~~~

~Accounting & Billing — **Core Part of the Role**~

You will own the billing cycle end to end and be the first line of review on all financial activity.  As we have about 15 customers this is important work, yet not the time spent task.  

**2-4 years experience is required.**



~Invoicing & Billing~

- Review Microsoft 365 license counts via Ingram Micro before each billing cycle to ensure every license is accounted for and billed correctly to the right client

- Cross-reference Ingram Micro invoices for hardware and software purchases — confirm what was ordered, delivered, and billed to the client matches

- Prepare accurate client invoices in Wave Accounting

- Review invoice counts and amounts before invoices go out — catch errors before clients see them

- Send client statements and follow up on overdue invoices professionally



~Payments & Deposits~

- Process incoming electronic payments and match them to open client invoices in Wave Accounting

- When the owner deposits a cheque by bank scan, a photo of the cheque will be uploaded to SharePoint — you will be notified and are responsible for marking the deposit against the correct invoice in Wave

- Track all deposits and flag any discrepancies



~Credit Card & Expense Review~

- Regularly review company credit card statements

- Match charges to client accounts or internal cost categories

- Flag any unrecognized or suspicious charges as potential fraud

- Initiate disputes through the appropriate channel when required



~Accounting Inbox — 

- Monitor and manage the accounting inbox

- Respond to client billing questions and payment inquiries professionally

- Process vendor invoices received by

- Confirm payment receipts and send acknowledgements

- Escalate anything requiring owner decision



~~~~~~~~~~

~Operations Monitoring~

- Monitor support tickets in our Kaseya software stack

- Flag unresolved issues

- Ensure documentation is kept up to date



~~~~~~~~~~

~Growth Support~

- Maintain prospect quotes and follow up

- Help organize proposals

- Help hire and work with Marketing Manager



~~~~~~~~~~

~AI & Automation — Central to This Role~

We do not expect you to do everything manually. We expect you to figure out what AI can do, set it up, manage the output, and escalate only what needs a human decision.



- Identify repetitive tasks and build AI workflows to handle them

- Manage and review AI-generated outputs before they reach clients or the founder

- Continuously look for ways to do more with less manual effort

- Help the company build systems that scale without adding headcount



The goal is not for you to work harder. It is for you to work smarter — and help the whole company do the same.



Over time, your role will shift from doing the work to managing the systems that do the work. That is the direction we are heading, and we want someone who is excited about that future — not threatened by it.



~~~~~~~~~~

~Required Skills~

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Bookkeeping or invoicing experience — you must be comfortable working with numbers and financial records

- Experience with AI tools and automation



~~~~~~~~~~

~Helpful Experience~

- Wave Accounting or similar bookkeeping software

- Microsoft 365 and SharePoint

- PSA or ticketing systems (e.g. Kaseya)

- Distributor or vendor invoice reconciliation

- AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar)



~~~~~~~~~~

~Tools We Use~

- Wave Accounting

- Ingram Micro distributor portal

- Kaseya software stack

- Microsoft 365 and SharePoint

- PSA / ticketing systems

- Spreadsheets and documentation tools

- AI tools — and we are always adding more



~~~~~~~~~~

~Personality We Are Looking For~

- Extremely organized

- Detail-focused — billing errors cost us money and client trust

- Proactive problem solver — you fix things before being asked

- Calm and dependable

- Trustworthy with financial information

- Genuinely excited about building better systems

- You see AI as a tool that makes you more powerful, not a threat to your job

- Reliable, consistent, and self-managed



~~~~~~~~~~

~Weekly Report You Will Own~

- Invoices sent

- Payments received and deposits processed

- Overdue invoices and follow-up status

- Credit card review status and any flagged charges

- Operational issues needing attention

- Priorities for the coming week



~~~~~~~~~~

~Long-Term Opportunity~

As AI takes over more of the routine work, this role grows with it. Your path could lead to:



- Operations Manager

- Finance Coordinator

- Automation & Process Manager



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us for years, not months — and who wants to be part of building something, not just maintaining it.



~~~~~~~~~~

~How to Apply~

To be considered, your application must include all four of the following:



1. Your experience with operations, admin, or bookkeeping — be specific about what you did

2. The tools you have used — software, platforms, and AI tools

3. A specific example of how you have used AI to save time or improve a process

4. An example of a time you caught a billing or financial error before it became a problem



~Bonus Task — complete this to stand out:~

Review the following client billing summary:



Client A | 12 devices | 10 licenses billed | 12 on record | Oct 1 | Unpaid | 45 days overdue

Client B | 8 devices | 8 licenses billed | 8 on record | Oct 15 | Paid

Answer these three questions:



1. Which clients have a billing discrepancy and what is the issue with each?

2. Which clients need immediate payment follow-up and why?

3. How would you use an AI tool to automate the overdue invoice follow-up process so you are managing it rather than writing each
 manually? Describe your approach in 2-3 sentences.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

title: Virtual Admin Assistant
description:
We're looking for a Virtual Event Administrator to join our growing team!



If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy keeping projects organized, and love bringing events to life behind the scenes, this could be the perfect role for you. You'll play a key role in coordinating events from initial inquiry through successful execution, working closely with clients, vendors, and internal team members to ensure every detail is attended to. No two days look the same, and that's exactly what makes this role exciting.



Our SCORE Values



Solution-Focused – Think critically and proactively solve problems.

Curiosity – Ask questions and always seek to learn.

Ownership – Take accountability for your work and follow through.

Resourcefulness – Find answers, adapt quickly, and make things happen.

Excellence – Deliver high-quality work and outstanding service.

Hint: During your interview, tell us which SCORE value you identify with the most for bonus points.



Who You Are



• You have a strong administrative background and are comfortable managing calendars, inboxes, documents, contracts, proposals, quotes, and invoices.

• You're highly organized and naturally stay on top of deadlines without constant reminders.

• You've coordinated vendors, venues, contractors, or third-party partners and know how to keep multiple moving pieces on track.

• You bring structure to ambiguity and enjoy creating organized processes.

• You're professional, proactive, detail-oriented, and genuinely enjoy helping people.

• When challenges arise, you focus on finding solutions, not assigning blame.



Role Requirements



• Pristine English proficiency (Written and Verbal).

• 2+ years working with clients from the United States.

• 2+ years of virtual assistant experience (or relevant administrative experience).

• Must have a reliable backup internet connection.

• Experience with a variety of CRM tools and G-Suite.

• Reliable internet connection with a backup; ability to work scheduled remote hours consistently. (Minimum: Download Speed +20 MB / Upload Speed 5 MB).

• A Computer: At least 8GB of RAM and an Intel Core 8th generation processor or higher, or AMD Ryzen 2000 series or higher.

• Operating system: Windows 11 or higher / macOS 13 or higher.

• Working camera and microphone.



What You'll Do



• Manage the complete event workflow from inquiry to completion.

• Prepare quotes, proposals, contracts, invoices, and follow-up communications.

• Serve as the primary point of contact throughout each event.

• Coordinate vendors, venues, contractors, and internal team members.

• Build detailed timelines and event documentation.

• Maintain accurate CRM records and track event progress.

• Monitor inventory, supplies, and event equipment.

• Support administrative operations including scheduling, inbox management, and meeting notes.

• Assist with lead generation, outreach, and marketing initiatives during slower periods.



Nice to Have

• Experience with weddings, corporate events, AV/production, catering, food & beverage, or similar industries.

• Experience creating SOPs or improving internal systems.



Benefits



Starting on Day One

• 7 paid company holidays

• Virtual team socials and game nights

• Bi-monthly professional development and team training

After 3 Months

• 1 local holiday each year

• $100 annual professional development allowance

• One-time $50 home office reimbursement

• 10 PTO days plus 3 paid sick days annually

After 1 Year

• Healthcare reimbursement of up to $50/month for eligible expenses

• Additional one-time $50 home office reimbursement

• Eligibility for a discretionary year-end performance bonus



You can apply via this link: https://www.yourstartupoperations.com/job-openings/virtual-admin-assistant



Looking forward to learning more about you!

title: Content Assistant
description:
We are seeking a dependable, well-organized, and meticulous Virtual Assistant to help oversee our day-to-day User-Generated Content (UGC) workflow. The primary objective of this position is to ensure creator-submitted content is processed accurately, consistently, and according to established procedures.



Your daily responsibilities will involve accessing our ARUGC creator portal, downloading the latest video submissions, and evaluating, testing, and categorizing one newly submitted video each day. Once a video has been verified, you will publish the approved content to our internal platform, examine all accompanying metadata to confirm its accuracy and completeness, and forward the finalized files together with their metadata to the manager for final verification and approval.



The daily workload is relatively small, generally requiring about one hour to complete. Success in this role depends on maintaining a consistent routine, paying close attention to detail, and following established workflows without deviation. This opportunity is well suited for someone who is proactive, highly organized, capable of working independently, and committed to maintaining high standards of quality throughout the content management process.

title: Creative & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
Canva, Lightroom Classic, Data Entry , Ai, Chat GPT and Online Business Support jack of all trades  VA :)



I am looking for a dependable, creative, and detail-oriented virtual assistant to support my growing school photography and online education businesses.



This will begin as a four-month part-time partnership, with the potential to develop into a longer-term position for the right person. My business is growing, and I would love to find someone who is excited to learn, take ownership of their work, and grow alongside me as the role expands.



About the Business



I own a family-operated school photography company in Florida. We photograph schools, preschools, dance studios, and other organizations. I am also building an online education business that teaches photographers how to enter the school photography industry and create more freedom and stability in their businesses.



This role will include a combination of creative work, administrative support, photo editing, and helping me organize and build new resources for my students.



Initial Responsibilities



Your tasks may include:

• Designing polished Canva graphics for static social media posts, ads

• Creating worksheets, onboarding roadmaps, PDFs, checklists, and other student resources

• Data entry and organizing information in spreadsheets, canva designs

• Assisting with school photography administrative tasks 

• Learning GotPhoto (photo platform for schools) and eventually helping with gallery setup, roster information, QR codes, and other backend tasks

• Basic Editing of school portraits and other photography work in Lightroom Classic (must be able to handle volume)

• Following established editing styles and maintaining consistency across large batches of images

• Organizing files, resources, and business systems

• Helping with additional creative and operational projects as the businesses grow



The Right Person

You may be a great fit if you:

• Have experience editing photos in Lightroom Classic

• Have a good eye for clean, attractive, and cohesive design

• Are comfortable using Canva

• Are highly organized and pay close attention to details

• Can follow instructions carefully and also think independently

• Communicate clearly when you have questions or need clarification

• Meet deadlines and provide updates without needing to be repeatedly reminded

• Are comfortable learning new software and systems

• Are interested in a position that could grow in responsibilities and hours over time

• Care about doing excellent work, even on repetitive tasks



I am not looking for someone who rushes through tasks simply to finish them. I am looking for someone thoughtful, reliable, and interested in becoming a trusted part of the business.



Hours and Compensation



This is a part-time independent contractor position beginning with a four-month commitment.

Starting pay is $5–$7 USD per hour (number of hours to be determined), depending on experience and skill level.



There will be an opportunity to review compensation as your skills, independence, and responsibilities within the business grow.



The position will begin with a small paid trial project so we can both make sure the partnership feels like a good fit.



Most working hours can be flexible, but you must be reliable about agreed-upon deadlines and available for occasional communication during Florida business hours.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:

A short introduction about yourself and why this position interests you

Your experience with Lightroom Classic, Canva, graphic design, data entry, and virtual-assistant work

Examples of Canva designs, PDFs, social media graphics, or other creative work you have completed



The word “Grow” at the beginning of your application so I know you read the entire post



Please be honest about the skills you already have and the areas where you would need training. I do not expect one person to be an expert in everything. Reliability, attention to detail, creativity, communication, and a willingness to learn are extremely important to me.



I am excited to find someone who wants more than a collection of random tasks and would enjoy becoming an important part of a growing creative business.

title: AI Developer
description:

- Building a range of internal tools for the team, the kind of things that remove manual work and speed up how we operate

- Working across APIs and integrations, including GoHighLevel, to connect the systems we run on

- Partnering with the team on what gets built and why. We work as a team to win, and you'd own the technical thinking on your side of it



Within the first 30 to 60 days, success looks like you showing up with the plan. You should be telling us what we should build next, how to approach it, and in what order. You should have a clear point of view on what's worth automating, what isn't, and what you want to ship first. The bar here is strategic ownership of the build, not waiting for a backlog to be handed to you.



Schedule



Work hours are flexible but need to overlap with our team between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST during active project work. Just want to make sure you can meet inside that window.

- An AI-first mindset. You use AI as a real working partner every day, and it shows in how you work.

- Independent problem-solving. You think first, use AI to amplify your thinking, and verify before shipping anything.

- A strategy-first approach. You're someone who shows up with the plan and tells us what we should be building, testing, and improving. You partner with our team on execution, but you lead the thinking on your work.

- Deep comfort with Claude Code, GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, working with APIs, and the GoHighLevel API. We're also genuinely interested in whatever else you've built your workflow around.

- A real love for this work. That comes through fast in conversation, and we'd rather hire someone who has it than someone who's just qualified.



How to Apply



A few things we'd love you to do, in order:



1. Please start your reply with the word "Jamal." We use this as a small check to spot applicants who read instructions carefully. Without it, we won't be able to review your application.



2. Record a 5-minute video answering the questions below. No script needed. We just want to get a feel for how you think.



3. Share your full tool stack with self-ratings (1 to 10). These ones we already know we need:

   - Claude Code    /10

   - GitHub    /10

   - Supabase    /10

   - Vercel    /10

   - Working with APIs    /10

   - GoHighLevel API    /10



   Then add every other tool you use, one per line, with /10. Include AI tools, frameworks, automation platforms, niche services, spreadsheets you've built, the works. Honesty matters more than scoring high. The video will give us a sense of where you actually are.



4. Walk us through your work history. For your last 2 or 3 clients or accounts:

   - What size was the company or account when you started (team size, what they were running, what was manual before you came in, whatever metric fits)?

   - What did you build for them?

   - What was the outcome? Where were they when you started, and where are they now?

   - If you have current clients, where are those projects today?



   We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better.



5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above.



How You Use AI



In your video, spend a minute or so on this. The more specific the better:



- Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally

- A specific example of a build task in this role where AI saves you real time, and how you use it

- A time AI gave you a wrong or bad output. How you caught it, and what you did about it

- Anything you've intentionally chosen NOT to let AI do in your work, and why



We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story.



A Few Questions for Your Video



Take these in order, and just talk through them naturally.



1. If you came on next week and we asked you to build out our internal tooling, walk us through your first 30 days. What would you want to look at, what would you build first, and how would you d
 the order?

2. We hand you a vague request like "we need something to make X less painful," with no spec. Walk us through how you go from that sentence to a shipped tool.

3. An automation you built has started silently failing in production. Walk us through what you check first and how you track it down.

4. Why do you love building this kind of thing? Tell us about a recent tool or automation you shipped that reminded you why you do this work.

5. What's something about building with Claude Code, MCP, or agentic workflows that's changed in the last year that you've actually adjusted your approach around?

description:
PERSONAL / EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT — LONG-TERM, FULL-TIME ROLE



Remote | $8/hr, bi-weekly pay | 9am–5pm US Pacific



WHO I AM



I'm an entrepreneur based in Southern California. I run a digital marketing agency serving home-service businesses, and I'm a coach inside a paid coaching program for marketing agency owners. Between the two, I manage roughly 80 client and member relationships.



You can check me 
 on instagram, 



THE ROLE



You will be MY assistant. Not the agency's assistant, not the coaching program's assistant — mine. Your job is to protect my time, carry my communication load, and make my life simpler. The work happens to live mostly inside client success and member communication, but the role follows me: if I need help with something personal or business-related during work hours, that's part of the job.



This is not a task-list VA role. I need someone who thinks, notices, and takes ownership.



Your core responsibilities:

- Manage day-to-day communication with coaching members and agency clients on my behalf — in my voice, to my standard

- Track member engagement and flag disengaged members early, then run reactivation outreach

- Follow up on failed payments and renewals using our existing AI-powered systems

- Complete weekly and monthly reports; keep member data updated

- Collect testimonials, schedule case-study interviews, and ask for referrals

- Surface problems before they become problems, and suggest the SOPs and systems we should build as issues come up

- Personal-assistant support during work hours — scheduling, research, errands that can be done remotely, whatever I need off my plate



Important: most of the mechanical work (payment follow-up, reporting, tracking) is already automated with AI tools. Your job is to USE those tools consistently and apply human judgment where it's needed. You won't be building from scratch — but you must be sharp enough to notice gaps and propose fixes without being told.



HOW ONBOARDING WORKS (FIRST 21 DAYS, PAID)

- Week 1: You shadow me. Watch how I communicate, learn the members, learn the tools.

- Week 2: We build the SOPs and playbook together — you hold the pen.

- Week 3: You take over communications while I watch and give feedback.

- Day 22+: You own it. We meet daily for a 15–30 min 1:1, but I will not manage you task by task.



I think of this seat as the cornerstone of how everything I do runs — hire the right person once, invest in them, and build for years. That word matters; you'll want to remember it when you record your Loom, where I'd like you to work it in naturally within your first minute.



COMPENSATION & TERMS

- $8/hr, full-time (40 hrs/week), paid bi-weekly

- Performance review at 6 months with a $2/hr raise on strong performance

- Hours: 9am–5pm US Pacific Time — confirm you can sustain this schedule long-term before applying

- Time tracking via Hubstaff/Time Doctor

- This must be your ONLY job. No side clients, no other employers.

- 100% long-term, stable role.



REQUIREMENTS

- Fluent, natural written English (you'll be writing to US business owners daily, as me)

- Prior experience supporting a busy professional, executive, or agency owner — with references I can contact

- Extreme attention to detail

- A love of simplifying things — you see a messy process and itch to clean it up

- Proactive: you flag issues, propose solutions, and take accountability when something slips

- Honest, transparent, kind, loyal

description:

THE ROLE



You will be MY assistant. Not the agency's assistant, not the coaching program's assistant — mine. Your job is to protect my time, carry my communication load, and make my life simpler. The work happens to live mostly inside client success and member communication, but the role follows me: if I need help with something personal or business-related during work hours, that's part of the job.



This is not a task-list VA role. I need someone who thinks, notices, and takes ownership.



Your core responsibilities:

- Manage day-to-day communication with coaching members and agency clients on my behalf — in my voice, to my standard

- Follow up on failed payments and renewals using our existing AI-powered systems

- Surface problems before they become problems, and suggest the SOPs and systems we should build as issues come up

- Personal-assistant support during work hours — scheduling, research, errands that can be done remotely, whatever I need off my plate



Important: most of the mechanical work (payment follow-up, reporting, tracking) is already automated with AI tools. title: Short-Form Video Editor — Studio/Produced Meta Ads (Full-Time)
description:
We're a US-based DTC brand hiring a full-time short-form video editor to build high-converting paid social ads (Meta, 9:16 vertical) from studio and produced footage.

This is not UGC/talking-head editing. You'll be working with polished product footage and creator-supplied B-roll, and building the ad yourself — constructing the hook, the story, and the pacing from raw material rather than sharpening an existing performance. We're looking for someone with strong creative instincts who can make an ad land without a creator narrating it for them.

What you'll do:



Edit 15s / 30s / 40s vertical ads from studio footage + creator B-roll

Build hooks from product and lifestyle footage — no talking head to carry it

Use motion graphics, text-on-screen, sound design, and pacing to drive the message and the CTA

Make your own creative calls on structure, cuts, music, and typography

Deliver consistent daily output (roughly 5–6 short edits/day once ramped)



You must have:



Strong short-form/paid-social editing experience with produced or branded footage — portfolio required

Real motion graphics ability (After Effects or equivalent). This is essential, not optional.

A sharp instinct for hooks and retention in vertical video without relying on a creator's performance

Excellent written English, reliable full-time availability, and the confidence to work independently



Nice to have: DTC/ecommerce ad experience, sound design, Meta Ads familiarity, jewelry/lifestyle/product-focused work.

To apply: Start your reply with the word "BROLL" so I know you read this. Include 2–3 links to vertical ads you personally edited that don't rely on a talking-head creator — product, studio, or B-roll-driven work. For one of them, tell me in a line or two how you built the hook without a person speaking. Applications without samples or the code word won't be reviewed.



Skills: Video Editing · Adobe After Effects · Adobe Premiere Pro (After Effects moves up in priority here)

Wage: This skillset commands more than UGC assembly — motion graphics plus creative construction is a genuinely scarcer combination. I'd post $800–$1,100/month full-time and expect the strong candidates to sit at the top of it. Your $5/video math strains at this tier; at ~$900 and 120 edits/month you're closer to $7.50/video. That's the honest cost of the skill, and it's worth d
 now whether you'd rather stretch the budget or accept fewer, better edits.

Two things I'd change in your screening funnel for this role specifically:

The portfolio filter gets stricter. Most editors' reels are stuffed with UGC because that's where the volume is. Explicitly asking for non-talking-head samples is what separates them, and a lot of applicants simply won't have any. That's the point.

The trial task should give them the hard version. Send studio footage plus B-roll with no voiceover and no script — and let them build. Same brief structure as before, but the hook question becomes the whole evaluation: how did you stop the scroll with no one talking? An editor who can answer that convincingly is rare and worth paying for.

One practical suggestion: run this as a separate posting from the UGC role rather than one combined "video editor" post. The talent pools barely overlap, and a combined post gets you a flood of UGC editors who'll all fail the B-roll test.

Want me to draft the trial brief for this version — the studio/B-roll build-from-scratch test?

title: Full-Stack Python Developer — Automation, Scraping & AI
description:
We're a real estate company that runs on a lot of custom software, and we're building more of it continuously. We're looking for an experienced software developer to take ownership of a real, running production system — not a no-code tinkerer. If you've built and shipped backend services in Python, wrangled Postgres by hand, deployed with Docker, and can reverse-engineer a stubborn government web portal, keep reading. If your experience is mostly drag-and-drop automation tools, this role isn't the right fit.



The Role

This is a long-term role, not a one-off gig. Your first job is to finish a project that's already in progress — an existing production codebase with a Python backend, a fleet of web scrapers, LLM-powered research pipelines, and the workflow automation that ties it all together. From there, there's a long runway of new software to build. We're growing our custom tooling continuously and want someone who'll grow with it.



This is a builder-owner role. You'll own features from idea to deployment and be responsible for code that runs every day. The person who built the current system set a high bar — we need someone who can read that codebase, understand why it's built the way it is, and improve it without breaking it.



A Great Environment to Build In

You won't be working in a vacuum. Our team is technical, so you'll work directly with people who understand the code and the system. It's a fluid, collaborative setup — you'll be able to get started right away, get your questions answered quickly, and get the support you need to move fast. No waiting days for someone non-technical to unblock you.



What You'll Work On

A Python (FastAPI) REST backend with a PostgreSQL database — raw SQL, no ORM crutches

Web scrapers against county portals, court records, and public data sources — including JS-rendered sites and anti-bot systems

AI-assisted research and enrichment pipelines (property, legal, and public records)

Document generation, structured data extraction, and routing workflows

Integrations between our custom CRM and external data sources

Workflow automations (n8n) and the job queues that feed the scrapers





Must-Have (we can't train these)

Strong Python (3.11+) — years of it, in production, not tutorials

PostgreSQL and hand-written SQL — comfortable without an ORM

Docker / docker-compose — everything runs in containers, staging and prod

Git with a disciplined branch/deploy workflow (local ? staging ? prod)

REST APIs, webhooks, JSON — you can read docs and integrate anything

Web scraping fundamentals — requests/httpx, BeautifulSoup, HTTP sessions and cookies, and the patience to reverse-engineer messy legacy portals





Strongly Preferred

Playwright (Python) for JS-rendered sites and browser automation

Redis or similar for job queues; concurrency patterns (thread pools, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)

LLM APIs in real systems (Anthropic/Claude, OpenAI) — used in production, not just prompting a chatbot

n8n or comparable workflow automation

Experience with anti-bot / CAPTCHA handling, proxies, or headless-display setups





Nice to Have

React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind (we have a frontend you may touch)

GIS basics — geopandas/shapely, shapefile/GeoJSON

JWT / RBAC auth, nginx, Cloudflare

pytest + GitHub Actions CI





Schedule & Flexibility

You'll mainly work on Philippine time. All we ask is a small daily overlap with US business hours — roughly 1 to 3 hours — which for most people means a few hours in the evening to sync, ask questions, and stay aligned. The rest of your day is yours to structure around your life.



This role rewards independent work. Once you're up to speed, you'll be trusted to run with things on your own schedule, with the team available during the overlap window whenever you need input or unblocking.



Pay for Results

Beyond your base pay, we offer significant bonuses for shipping projects and hitting milestones. If you're the kind of builder who moves fast and gets things across the finish line, there's real upside here — we'd rather reward completed, working software than count hours.



You'll Thrive Here If You

Have shipped and maintained production software that other people depend on

Debug independently, read source when docs fall short, and flag problems early

Care about doing things the right way, but ship pragmatically

Communicate clearly and don't need to be micromanaged





How to Apply

Tell us about a backend or scraping system you built and personally shipped — what it did, the stack, and one hard technical problem you solved. Links to code (GitHub, etc.) get bumped to the top of the pile.



Please note: this is a software engineering role. Applications describing only no-code / drag-and-drop automation experience won't be a fit.

title: Head of Brand & Marketing
description:
Christo's is an Australian smash-burger and fried-chicken chain scaling from 3 stores towards 12 and beyond. We believe fast food should be legendary — and we're hiring the person who makes sure everyone else believes it too.



This is not a 'manage the socials' seat. You are our senior marketing function: you own how Christo's looks, sounds and grows across every public channel, you own the founder's personal brand, and you own the marketing engine behind every new store opening. You work directly with the CEO, run a content pipeline, direct Perth-based creators and crews remotely, and use tools like Claude, Notion and Meta Ads Manager daily. This is a senior seat: you'll be paid top of market and we expect top performance.



Who you'll work with

You report to the CEO (Gav) and work alongside his Executive Assistant, the Operations Manager and you will direct external creators - videographers, editor etc - and brief in-store teams who execute activations on the ground in Perth. Perth and the Philippines share the same time zone, so you work our hours live, not overnight.



What you'll own

1. Brand direction: the visual and tonal standard for Christo's across every channel, store asset and campaign. Keep the brand manual current and enforced; run monthly brand-compliance reviews using store photo audits.

2. Founder brand: Gav's content calendar, scripts, hooks and narrative — make him the most recognisable food founder in Perth. He shoots; you make everything else happen.

3. Content engine: own the social calendar across all platforms; brief and manage editors and videographers; keep the pipeline 4+ weeks ahead; hold the creative standard.

4. Campaigns: plan and run the campaign calendar — brand 
nts, promos and local store marketing. Every campaign gets an objective, a budget and a post-mortem with numbers.

5. Paid media: Meta and Google ads — strategy, build, budget, and ROAS reporting.

6. New-store launches: own launch marketing for stores 4 and 5 — teaser campaigns, opening-week activations (executed by our Perth crew to your runsheet), local partnerships.

7. Reviews & community: own the review loop (Google, socials) — responses in brand voice, insights fed back to operations weekly.

8. Influencers & partnerships: identify, brief, contract and review Perth creators and community partners — managed remotely, measured on results.

9. Reporting: weekly brand report to the CEO (social metrics, campaign status, review scores) and a monthly performance report tying marketing spend to store sales.

10. Systems & AI: build the marketing OS in Notion, document how everything runs, and use AI aggressively to make a small team punch far above its size.



What good looks like

Within 30 days: the content pipeline runs 4 weeks ahead without the CEO chasing it; the weekly brand report lands every Monday; review response time is under 24 hours; and the store 4 launch marketing plan exists with dates and owners. Within 90 days: store 4 opens loud, follower growth and foot traffic are measurably moving, and Gav's personal brand output is consistent and compounding./



You're right for this if you

Have 5+ years in brand/social/content marketing with real outcomes you can show (accounts you grew, campaigns you ran, launches you led); have managed creatives — editors, videographers, designers — to a standard; think in brand first and read numbers second, but you do read them; run Meta Ads competently; write sharp, native-level English copy; are fluent with AI tools and use them daily; and take full ownership. Food, hospitality or retail brand experience is a strong plus. Agency background welcome — but this is an owner's seat, not an account manager's.



To apply

Start your message with the word LEGENDARY so I know you read this. Then: (1) link the best brand or account you've personally run, with one number that proves it worked; (2) name a food brand doing social brilliantly right now and tell me why in 3 sentences; (3) one line on how you use AI in your marketing work today.

title: Marketing Team Member — Digital, Social, and Content (4 Roles)
description:
Read This First

We are not looking for someone to "manage social media." We are looking for four sharp marketers who can execute across a portfolio of real, revenue-generating companies in mental health, medical tourism, equine-assisted therapy, and wellness. If you need hand-holding, this is not your job. If you want to own your work and grow with us, keep reading.



What You Will Actually Do

You will execute digital marketing, social media, faceless YouTube content, and brand design across multiple companies. You will plan content, ship it, measure it, and improve it. You will not just post. You will help build audiences and pipelines.



Who You Are

You have run social accounts that have grown. You have worked on a YouTube channel and can prove it. You design clean assets in Canva or Adobe without supervision. You edit a video that holds attention. You understand SEO, paid ads on Google and Meta, and you read analytics like a native language. You handle multiple brands without dropping the ball, and you make decisions based on data, not vibes.



Non-Negotiables

You work the graveyard shift. You have a quiet home office, fast and stable internet, your own computer, and noise-cancelling headphones. You are available immediately for full-time work. You are comfortable with the pay range above.



What You Get

Remote work. A long-term seat on a team building across industries. Real exposure to multi-brand marketing and YouTube growth at scale. Room to grow for the right people.



How to Stand Out

The candidates who have wowed us in the past did more than answer questions. They sold themselves like they sell brands. If you want to get our attention, send us:



- A portfolio link with real work you actually shipped (channels, accounts, ad campaigns, design samples, edited videos).

- A short marketing video pitching yourself the same way you would pitch a client. Show us your hook, your editing, your personality.

- Screenshots or case studies with real numbers. Followers grown, views earned, leads generated, ad spend managed, ROAS, watch time. Vanity metrics without context will not impress us.

- A mock content idea, thumbnail, or 30-second concept for one of our industries (mental health, medical tourism, equine therapy, or wellness). You do not need to be perfect. You need to show you can think.



If you skip this section, you can still apply. But the people who do this are the ones who get hired.



How to Apply (Read Carefully)

Applications without an audio file will be ignored. No exceptions.



Record an audio application, upload it to Google Drive, and include the link in your written application. In the audio, answer all of the following:



Your digital marketing and social media experience, with specifics and numbers.

YouTube channels you have worked on, your role, and what happened to the channel.

Your design and video editing tools, and your comfort level with each.

Your SEO and paid ads experience, with platforms and results.

How you handle work across multiple brands without things slipping.

A time you used data to change a marketing decision.

Any admin or virtual assistant experience.

Cold calling or outbound experience.

Confirmation you can work the graveyard shift.

Your home situation and any responsibilities that affect your work.

Your office setup, internet speed, computer, and headphones.

Distractions in your home (children, pets, family).

Whether you can start immediately full-time.

Whether the ?20,000–?35,000/month range works for you.



If your audio is vague, generic, or sounds like every other application, we will pass. Be specific. Be honest. Show us how you think.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property/SaaS-tech, remote)
description:
Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: AI & Business Process Automation Consultant
description:
AI & Business Process Automation Consultant (Accounting Firm)



About Us



Executive Financial Solutions (EFS) is a growing accounting and advisory firm based in The Bahamas. We provide bookkeeping, payroll, financial reporting, compilation engagements, audits, advisory, and business consulting services to small and medium-sized businesses.



We are seeking an AI & Business Process Automation Consultant to work directly with the firm’s Managing Principal on a 3–6 month implementation project. The objective is to redesign how our firm operates by leveraging AI and automation to improve efficiency, consistency, scalability, and the overall client experience.



This is not a role for someone who simply knows how to use AI tools. We are looking for someone who can evaluate our current operations, identify inefficiencies, redesign workflows, implement practical AI solutions, and help establish AI as a core part of how our firm operates.



Project Objectives



The successful consultant will:



* Review and document our current business processes.

* Identify repetitive and time-consuming tasks that can be improved through AI or automation.

* Design an AI operating model tailored specifically for our accounting firm.

* Implement practical AI workflows that improve both internal operations and client service delivery.

* Recommend integrations between our existing software and AI tools where appropriate.

* Develop standardized AI workflows that our entire team can use consistently.

* Train our team on the effective and responsible use of AI.

* Create documentation and SOPs for all implemented workflows.



AI Governance & Risk Management



Because we work with confidential client information, a key responsibility of this engagement will be developing an AI Governance Framework for our firm.



This includes:



* Developing firm-wide AI usage policies.

* Defining what information may and may not be entered into AI tools.

* Establishing procedures for protecting confidential and sensitive client information.

* Creating AI quality control and review procedures.

* Providing guidance on ethical AI use within an accounting firm.

* Developing staff guidelines, training materials, and best practices for responsible AI adoption.



Scope of Work



Potential projects include:



* Reviewing our bookkeeping workflow from client onboarding through financial reporting.

* Improving month-end close procedures.

* Developing AI-assisted bookkeeping review processes.

* Designing AI workflows for audit planning, analytical procedures, documentation support, and file reviews.

* Improving proposal preparation, engagement letters, and client communications.

* Building an internal AI knowledge base for firm procedures and technical accounting research.

* Identifying opportunities to automate repetitive administrative tasks.

* Recommending practical technology integrations before introducing new software.



Current Technology



Experience with some or all of the following is preferred:



* Claude AI

* Google Workspace

* QuickBooks Online (QBO)

* Excel

* Zapier and/or Make

* API integrations

* Workflow automation platforms

* Prompt engineering

* Document management systems



Ideal Candidate



The ideal consultant:



* Thinks like a business process consultant, not just an AI user.

* Has experience improving operational efficiency through AI and automation.

* Can independently evaluate workflows and recommend practical improvements.

* Understands systems integration and workflow design.

* Is comfortable implementing solutions, not just making recommendations.

* Can explain technical concepts in clear business language.

* Has excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Is proactive, organized, and able to manage projects independently.



Experience working with accounting firms, bookkeeping firms, or other professional service businesses is highly desirable but not mandatory.



Deliverables



By the end of the engagement, we expect to have:



* Documented maps of our core business processes.

* A customized AI strategy for the firm.

* Implemented AI workflows for selected operational areas.

* An AI Governance Framework, including policies and procedures for the responsible use of AI.

* Standard operating procedures for all implemented workflows.

* Team training materials and knowledge transfer sessions.

* A prioritized roadmap for future automation and technology investments.



Engagement Details



* Remote position.

* Part-time (approximately 15–20 hours per week).

* Estimated project duration: 3–6 months.

* Compensation: PHP 528 per hour.

* Potential for ongoing work based on performance.



To Apply



Please include:



1. A summary of your experience implementing AI and automation in businesses.

2. Examples of workflow improvement or automation projects you have completed.

3. The AI and automation tools you have worked with.

4. Your proposed approach to evaluating and improving an accounting firm’s operations.

5. Why you believe you are a good fit for this project.

6. Your availability and preferred working hours.



We are looking for someone who enjoys solving operational challenges, improving efficiency, and building scalable systems. Our goal is to create a modern, AI-enabled accounting firm where technology enhances—not replaces—professional judgment and exceptional client service.

title: Customer Care & Sales Specialist — US Cleaning Company | Long-Term Direct Hire | Paid Weekly
description:
**Long-term, direct-hire role with a growing US home-services company. No agency, no BPO middleman — you work directly for us.**



Clean Peachy is a residential cleaning company in Atlanta, Georgia. We're small, growing fast, and hiring our first dedicated customer care people. You'll own the whole customer relationship: you're the voice a new customer hears within five minutes of asking for a quote, the person who turns that inquiry into a booked cleaning, and the calm, capable person who fixes it when something goes wrong for an existing client. You'll join the team as one of our Peaches — it'll make sense on day one.



This is a real career seat, not a project gig. We pay a strong flat monthly rate — **paid weekly** — and we're hiring people we want to keep for years. Do well and there's a real growth path: our first hires are the pool we'll grow our next team lead from.



### What you'll do



- **Respond to new leads within 5 minutes** during your shift — by call, SMS, and Thumbtack message. Speed-to-lead is the heart of the sales side of this job.

- Qualify each lead (bedrooms, bathrooms, square footage, how often), generate a quote in our system, and **ask for the booking on the call**. Steer customers toward recurring service — it's our priority product.

- Follow up with leads who don't book right away, on a set cadence.

- **Call every new client the day after their first clean, 100% of the time.** Same-day outreach for any rating of 3 stars or below.

- Handle day-of problems: if a cleaner runs late or doesn't show, you re-dispatch a replacement through our staffing tools and keep the client informed.

- Handle quality complaints with a clear remedy ladder: listen, apologize once, then fix it — a redo clean, a small credit, or escalate to your lead.

- Run our cancel-save process: find out why, fix the cause, offer a remedy — and escalate before ever accepting a cancellation.

- Work inside our custom admin platform: every lead, text, call, and issue shows up in one inbox with buttons for everything, and the right script appears right where you're working. Quoting is a form (enter beds/baths/sqft, price comes out). You will never do mental math on pricing and you will never see a credit card number — payments are tokenized through Stripe.



### Hours



Full-time, ~40 hours/week. Our coverage window is **7:00am–7:00pm US Eastern** — overnight in the Philippines. Your shift is 8 hours inside that window (for example 7:00pm–3:00am or 11:00pm–7:00am Philippine time), Monday–Friday US days, plus a rotating Saturday block shared across the team. Sundays we're closed. This is a permanent overnight schedule — please only apply if that genuinely works for your life. The pay range already reflects the overnight schedule.



### Non-negotiables



- **Exceptional spoken AND written English.** You'll be on the phone and texting with American homeowners all day. Clear, warm, easy to understand.

- **You can sell AND you can serve.** You've asked strangers for the sale and gotten it, and you can absorb an angry customer's frustration without taking it personally — or giving away the store. Tell us about both.

- **Ownership.** You don't say "that's not my department." You say "I'll take care of this" — and then you do, or you escalate it properly.

- **Unflappable.** A no-show cleaner at 8 AM Atlanta time with an upset client on the line is a Tuesday, not a crisis.

- **The overnight shift (Philippine time), reliably, long-term.**

- **Backup internet AND backup power.** A brownout cannot take you offline mid-shift. You'll prove your setup inside the application — our form runs a real speed test on your connection and asks for a short video of your backup power. Come ready.

- A quiet workspace and a good headset.



### Pay



**$900–1,400 USD/month flat rate, paid weekly.**



What earns the top of the band: a track record of closing (not just dialing) — real numbers you can show us — near-native spoken English, and a trial week that proves you can book cleanings *and* save an unhappy client. If you're a genuinely proven closer, tell us — we'd rather pay $1,400 for someone who converts than $900 for someone who takes messages. (We know expert closers command $1,500–2,000; if that's you and you can prove it, apply anyway and say so.)



### Hiring process



1. **Your OnlineJobs.ph message** (see How to apply below). We read every one that passes the filter, and we send the candidates we like a link to our application.

2. **The application** — a short written screen (judgment scenarios, not policy trivia), a recorded voice sample, and an equipment check: a measured speed test plus your backup-power video — no screenshots, no honor system. All in your browser, one sitting, ~20 minutes. Use the headset, connection, and workspace you'd actually work with.

3. **Scenario round** — we play you short recordings of real customer situations; you record your replies (and type one — half this job is texting).

4. **Live roleplay call** with our team lead, for finalists.

5. **Paid trial week** on the live queue — you're onboarded, contracted, and paid for it.



### How to apply



Right here on OnlineJobs.ph — no external links, no forms yet.



**Start your application message with the single word PEACH** (first word, all caps). Messages that skip it are not read — it's our attention-to-detail filter, and this job is all about details. (Yes, we see the irony: the password for joining the Peaches is PEACH. Consider it a preview of the culture.)



Then, in the same message, tell us: your sales and/or customer-service experience with US customers (real numbers if you have them — close rate, CSAT, whatever you've got), confirmation that a permanent Philippine-overnight shift genuinely works for you, and a line about your backup internet + power setup.



We read every message that passes the filter, and if we like what we see, the application link comes to you. Talk soon.

title: Law Firm Billing & Finance Assistant
description:
Law Firm Billing & Finance Assistant — A+ English Writing and Speaking Skills Required



U.S.-based law firm seeks a detail-oriented, financially sharp assistant to manage invoicing, timekeeping, collections, and take on light fractional-CFO responsibilities. The law firm is virtual and works with corporate clients and realtors in the commercial and residential real estate industries. This is a great fit for someone who loves numbers, has real QuickBooks Online experience, and is comfortable being the person who keeps the firm's finances on track, not just the biller.



RESPONSIBILITIES – Success in this role looks like:

• Billing & invoicing: monthly timesheets and client invoices go out in Clio on time, every time 

• Vendor payments: vendor invoices get paid on time, with clean, up-to-date records

• Collections: outstanding balances get proactive follow-up, and overdue invoices keep trending down instead of piling up

• Financial oversight: the bookkeeper's monthly numbers get a sharp second look, the annual budget stays current without being asked, and QuickBooks Online is always audit-ready

• Trust accounting: IOLTA stays airtight — reconciled, compliant, and zero surprises

• Closings: support the paralegal to ensure commercial and residential closing ledgers balance, settlement statements get a genuine second set of eyes before they go out, and nothing slips through the cracks from contract to closing



REQUIREMENTS – You'll thrive in this role if:

• QuickBooks Online: is second nature — you reconcile accounts and read a P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement without hand-holding

• Trust/IOLTA accounting: rules and reconciliation for law firms aren't new to you

• Budgeting: you've built and managed one before, and you can explain the "why" behind a variance, not just report the number

• Clio: you're comfortable invoicing and billing matters in it (or a similar legal practice management platform)

• Collaboration: you're comfortable working alongside a paralegal on live transactions under closing deadlines

• Excel: your spreadsheet skills are strong — formulas, formatting, and basic reporting

• Written & Spoken English: is excellent — you'll be the one talking balances with clients and financials with the attorney

• Background: you've supported bookkeeping, controller, or fractional-CFO functions before, ideally for a U.S.-based company or law firm

• Discretion: financial information is handled confidentially

• Curiosity: you're excited to use AI and tech to make financial processes faster and more accurate



BENEFITS

The firm will pay a 13th month bonus (equal to the average of one month's pay). Nine paid holidays a year.



HOURS PER WEEK

This role will be expected to work 15–20 hours per week to start, Monday through Friday, with at least some hours overlapping 10:00am–5:00pm Eastern Standard Time. Hours may run higher during active closing periods, and may increase over time.



ADDITIONAL DETAILS

This job requires a high-speed, secure internet connection. You are expected to work from your own home.



HOW TO APPLY

To apply, please send your resume/CV highlighting your QuickBooks Online, budgeting, and trust accounting experience, a short cover letter, and your hourly pay requirement in USD.



Please use at least 7 Apply Points when applying.

You must understand how to analyse ads, stores, funnels, landing pages and performance signals to uncover products that are already proving demand and have the potential to scale.



## Your Responsibilities



* Research winning and emerging products every day

* Hunt through advertiser accounts,
 pages and active ad campaigns

* Look for unique products, clever mechanisms, strong visual demonstrations and “wow factor”

* Find products that solve clear problems or create strong emotional desire

* Copy and track competitor links, ad accounts, landing pages and product pages

* Validate products using specific online metrics and market signals

* Submit organised daily research with clear reasoning behind every recommendation



## What We Are Looking For



You must have a strong understanding of:



* Ecommerce and dropshipping product research

* Meta Ad Library research

* Advertiser and
 page hunting

* Product saturation and market timing

* Creative angles, hooks and ad concepts

* Landing-page and funnel analysis

* Product validation metrics

* Offer structure, pricing and perceived value

* The difference between a temporary trend and a scalable product



You should know how to find products by:



* Searching competitor ad accounts

 pages

* Copying and analysing landing-page URLs

* Exploring advertiser networks

Full-time

RED-LIGHT (decline): pay below cost-to-run; out-of-territory/heavy deadhead; service flagged as 'Flat Rate Fee not eligible' or chargeback-prone; or scheduling conflicts.

- Excellent written and spoken English (phone work with drivers)

Within the first six months, you will have built a platform capable of:

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems and building systems that scale.

title: Copywriter and Video Editor for E-com
description:
We are looking for someone who can both think and execute.



This is NOT a role for someone who only writes scripts, only edits videos or only generates AI content.



We need someone who can actually analyze creatives and clearly explain the difference between losing creatives and winning creatives.



We need someone who can explain why a creative is winning or losing — not just say that it has a “good hook” or “good editing.”



We need someone who understands direct-response marketing and knows that the goal is not to make beautiful content. The goal is to make people stop, believe, want the product and buy.



We need someone who can research the customer properly by studying reviews, comments, support questions, objections, competitors, existing creatives and performance data.



We need someone who can find the real customer problem, desire, fear or frustration — not just repeat generic benefits from the product page.



We need someone who can identify the customer’s current belief and replace it with a new explanation that makes our product the logical solution.



We need someone who can build every creative around one clear central thesis instead of trying to communicate ten different ideas in one video.



We need someone who can create pattern-interrupting hooks that stop the right customer, not random people who will never buy.



We need someone who understands that a hook must create curiosity while still making the product category, problem or desired outcome relevant within the first few seconds.



We need someone who knows how to visualize problems without making the creative look ridiculous, childish, overly dramatic or unserious.



We need someone who can handle sensitive topics with empathy and realism without blaming, insulting or embarrassing the customer.



We need someone who understands that visuals are not decoration. Every shot must qualify the audience, visualize the problem, explain the mechanism, prove a claim, handle an objection or drive action.



We need someone who can place the visual proof at the exact 
nt the claim is being made.



We need someone who understands the difference between showing the product and actually proving why the product works.



We need someone who can create realistic product demonstrations, comparisons, problem visualizations, outcome scenes and proof sequences.



We need someone who can use AI properly so the result looks realistic — NOT like you entered one prompt, accepted the first result and called it finished.



We need someone who can leverage AI to create product videos and images where the product remains completely consistent throughout the creative.



The product, color, shape, material, fit, packaging and construction must NOT suddenly change between scenes.



We need someone who notices incorrect anatomy, strange hands, unrealistic movement, broken physics, inconsistent lighting, fake fabric and other obvious AI mistakes.



We need someone who is willing to regenerate, edit, composite and refine scenes until they actually look believable.



We need someone who can create ads that do not feel or look like traditional ads but still convert like crazy.



We want native social content on the surface with strong direct-response structure underneath.



We do NOT want studio polish as the dominant surface.



We need someone who understands how real phone footage, imperfect framing, ordinary environments, believable lighting and natural delivery can create more trust than an expensive-looking commercial.



We need someone who can create UGC-style creatives, AI B-roll, product demonstrations, dialogue concepts, problem-reframe videos, reply-to-comment ads, list formats and other direct-response structures.



We need someone who can write natural scripts that sound like something a real person would say — not like an AI-generated advertisement.



We need someone who can write captions and voiceovers in simple, spoken and concrete language.



We need someone who understands pacing and can keep attention by introducing new proof, information and visuals without constantly changing the main message.



We need someone who can make creatives understandable during fast, sound-off scrolling while also making the voiceover sound natural when listened to without the visuals.



We need someone who can work across Swedish, Norwegian, Danish and English creatives and make sure the language actually sounds native.



We need someone who understands that translating words is not enough. The customer language, delivery, captions and cultural feeling must also match the market.



We need someone who can create several meaningful variations from one strong concept instead of constantly abandoning the strategy and producing random new videos.



We need someone who can separate and test variables such as the angle, hook, visual hook, proof, offer, creator and format.



We need someone who can review performance data, document what was tested and use the result to improve the next creative.



We need someone who can take a winning creative and identify exactly which belief changed, which proof made it believable and which visual carried that proof.



We need someone who cares about accuracy and does not invent reviews, customer results, research, guarantees, comparisons or product claims.



We need someone who follows briefs carefully, notices small details and delivers the correct number of creatives, languages, formats and variations.



We need someone who takes feedback seriously, fixes problems properly and does not make the same mistake repeatedly.



We need someone who is proactive and can think independently. We do not want to explain every shot, every prompt and every edit step by step.



We need someone who actually cares about the brand and the performance of the creatives.



The more money we make from your creatives, the more valuable you become to us and the more money you will make. Simple as that.



What we do NOT want



We do NOT want someone who thinks being a Creative Strategist means generating random scripts with ChatGPT.



We do NOT want someone who uses one AI prompt, accepts obvious mistakes and calls the content finished.



We do NOT want beautiful AI scenes that do not look believable.



We do NOT want inconsistent products, incorrect underwear, changing packaging, broken anatomy or unrealistic physics.



We do NOT want generic lifestyle B-roll that has no connection to the claim being made.



We do NOT want random clips of smiling women, people walking, coffee cups, sunsets or products spinning on a table unless the visual performs a clear strategic job.



We do NOT want cinematic commercials, excessive transitions, glossy lighting or expensive studio aesthetics to be the dominant surface.



We do NOT want creatives that immediately feel like advertisements.



We do NOT want generic clickbait hooks that attract attention without qualifying the customer.



We do NOT want hooks that promise something the rest of the video or landing page does not deliver.



We do NOT want copied TikTok trends without a clear reason for using them.



We do NOT want feature dumps where every product benefit is forced into one video.



We do NOT want five different angles competing inside the same creative.



We do NOT want vague claims such as “premium quality,” “game-changing,” “revolutionary” or “the ultimate solution” without visual proof.



We do NOT want scripts where the visuals are described as “show a woman,” “show the product” or “add lifestyle B-roll.”



We do NOT want creatives that look attractive but have no belief chain, mechanism, proof or reason to buy.



We do NOT want someone who prioritizes output volume over performance.



We do NOT want someone who blindly produces more creatives without learning from previous results.



We do NOT want someone who ignores the brief, submits the wrong language, creates one video when two were requested or leaves obvious problems unfinished.



We do NOT want someone who needs constant hand-holding or becomes defensive when receiving direct feedback.



We are not looking for someone who can simply make content.



We are looking for someone who can create performance creatives that make the customer understand:



This is for me.

This is the real problem.

This is why the product works.

This is the proof.

This is why I should buy now.
