title: Head Of Content - Strategy, Editing and Team Leadership (short and long form video)
description:
Job Title: Head of Content — Strategy, Editing, and Team Leadership (Short-Form & Long-Form Video)



About Us

We're a growing content brand in the dog training space with real audience traction across platforms:



: ~6,000 followers

TikTok: ~15,000 followers

YouTube: ~9,500 followers (short-form and long-form)

Instagram: ~2,600 followers (this is our weakest platform and where we most need help)



Our top videos have hit 200,000+ views, but those are outliers — a lot of our content is only pulling 300 views. Views and follower growth have been trending in the wrong direction, and we know we need a leader, not just another executor, to turn the trajectory around.



This is a career opportunity, not a gig. We're looking for someone who wants to build something.



Who This Role Is Really For

We think the ideal person for this role is someone who's been embedded on a serious content team — an established creator's back-end team, a top short-form agency, a podcast studio, or a growth-focused content studio — and has absorbed how the real systems work.



You know how to plug numbers into a framework. You've seen how the pros build hooks, structure retention, and diagnose declines. You've been using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Manus, or others) as part of your workflow, not as a gimmick — for research, ideation, scripting, and analysis.



Now you're ready to break out and lead your own operation. You want a brand you can put your fingerprints all over. You want a career, not a client.



If that's you, keep reading.



What This Role Is

You'll be our Head of Content. You'll own the growth strategy across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube (both short-form and long-form), and
. You'll lead our existing team, train new tea
mbers as we ramp content back up, and set the bar with your own edits.



Full transparency: at one point we were producing 10+ pieces of content per day with a team of five video editors. Right now we're down to one piece per day. We want to get back to that volume - but done properly, with content built for each platform rather than the same video reposted everywhere. That was one of the mistakes of our previous team, and it's not one we'll repeat.



You'll grow into running the entire content operation as we scale back up.



This Is a Full-Time, Exclusive Role

To be clear: we're hiring you to work 100% for us. Not as a freelance client, not as a side project alongside other agencies. Full-time, exclusive, no conflicts. In return, you get a real career path with a brand that's committed to investing in you and the team we build together.



What You'll Actually Do

Own multi-platform growth strategy: content pillars, hooks, retention structure, pinning, profile optimization, posting cadence

Audit our existing accounts and diagnose exactly why views and follower growth have stalled

Lead, mentor, and train our existing editing team, plus new tea
mbers we bring on as we scale

Edit videos yourself to model what "great" looks like and set the standard for the team

Build platform-specific content strategies - TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube long-form, and
 are five different games and should be treated that way

Analyze top-performing videos and systematize what makes them work

Track performance in Metricool and report weekly on what's moving the needle

Stay ahead of algorithm shifts across all platforms

Help us build the team back out to full production capacity as we scale



Who You Are

You're operating a few levels above "social media manager." You've either:



Worked in-house or under contract with an established creator, agency, or content studio, OR

Built and scaled your own accounts to a level that proves you understand growth at scale



Either path is welcome, but you need to actually be at that tier. This isn't a role for someone still learning the fundamentals.

You also:



Can read a set of analytics and tell a story with them - not just "this did well" but why, and what to do next

Understand the difference between views and follows, and know how to engineer the 
nt a viewer d
 to follow

Understand that TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube long-form, and
 are all different games

Can brief an editor so clearly they don't need to ask questions

Can also do the edit yourself at a high level

Have clear written English, and are comfortable on regular Google Meet calls (accent doesn't matter)

Use AI tools fluently as part of your workflow

Want a long-term, full-time, exclusive role where you can grow into leading a team



Bonus Points



Dog training, pet, or animal niche experience

Long-form YouTube growth experience (we have long-form running but it hasn't gained traction — we need someone who can change that)

You've turned around a declining account before

You've been part of a team that grew accounts into the hundreds of thousands or millions

You've scaled a content team's output significantly (going from low to high volume without dropping quality)



Tools We Use



Metricool (analytics and scheduling)

CapCut (editing)

Time Doctor (time tracking — everyone on the team uses it; this is how we verify hours)

Open to your recommendations on what else would help



Hours



Full-time, 40 hours per week (8 hours per day)

Long-term, exclusive role with real growth potential — this is a career, not a task list



How to Apply

Applications that skip these steps will be ignored:



Start your message with the phrase: "Head of Content ready."

Share links to accounts or channels you've personally grown or worked on at a strategic level. Include rough before/after numbers and timeframe. If you can't share links, don't apply.

Tell us: when an account's views and follower growth start declining, what are the first three things you look at, and in what order?

Describe one time you either turned around a declining account or diagnosed the specific reason a video underperformed. Be specific.

Tell us one thing you'd want to know about our business or our current content before proposing a strategy. (We want to see how you think, not what you already assume.)

Briefly: what AI tools are part of your workflow, and how do you actually use them?



A note on timing — please read this carefully:

There is no rush to submit your proposal. We will not be making a hire for at least 7–10 days. We're waiting for all applications to come in before making any decisions.

If you're the candidate reading this, please don't think of yourself as competing against a hundred pre-made résumé applicants. You're not. We'll be discarding every application that doesn't follow the format above. What we're looking for is one special person — and if you think that might be you, take extra time to make your application excellent.

We won't make any knee-jerk decisions. We'll be reading carefully and looking for the one. If that person is you, an outstanding application is your fast track in.

title: Data Analyst (Amazon eCommerce)
description:
RocketAMS is a fully remote Amazon eCommerce agency out of Australia, founded by ex-Amazon Australia employees with over $100M in collective sales experience. We are small, growing fast, and we win because our people are genuinely sharper than the people we compete against.



This is posted as a "Data Analyst" role. That is the entry point, not the ceiling. You will start in the numbers, and if you are as good as we think, you grow into running client accounts and leading. We are hiring for raw horsepower, not for a resume full of Amazon experience. We will teach you Amazon. We cannot teach you how to think.



Who we are actually looking for



We want one of two people:



The very smart one. You graduated near the top of your class, dean's list or equivalent, and you are the person friends call when they need a problem thought through properly. You see patterns in data other people miss and you enjoy it.



The sharp, magnetic one. You are quick, curious, and people trust you fast. You have led something, a team, a club, a project, and you want a path toward managing clients and eventually people.



Either way, you are switched on. You read carefully, you figure things out without being spoon-fed, and you get quietly annoyed when a process is dumber than it needs to be, then you fix it.



What you will actually do



Own a small set of client accounts end to end on the backend, with a senior manager guiding you.

Turn Amazon sales, advertising, and marketplace data into clear findings the team can act on, not just charts.

Build and automate recurring reports so nobody does the same manual work twice. Google Sheets to start, and we will hand you AI tooling as fast as you can take them.

Spot better ways to run things and build them. Process automation is a core part of this role, not a "nice to have".

Work directly with brand managers and specialists, learning the strategy side while you support it.

What you need



A track record of being excellent at hard things, academic, professional, or both.

Strong, fast reasoning and genuine comfort with numbers.

Advanced Google Sheets or Excel, and the appetite to learn Amazon quickly.

Clear written English and the judgement to know what matters in a pile of data.

You do not need Amazon experience. You do need to be the kind of person who picks it up in weeks.



What you get



A real career path from analyst to account management to leadership, on merit and speed, not tenure.

Reviewing product tests and d
 when to kill, pause, duplicate, or scale campaigns

Managing campaign performance across multiple European markets

Identifying whether performance issues come from the campaign setup, creative, funnel, offer, product, or market

Helping us create a repeatable system for testing and scaling products

Flagging issues quickly when campaigns, tracking, or performance break

Providing clear written updates about what is happening inside the ad accounts



What We’re Looking For:



2+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience

Proven experience with ecommerce, dropshipping, or direct-response offers

Experience with funnel dropshipping is a strong plus

Comfortable managing multiple campaigns, products, and markets at the same time

Strong understanding of campaign testing, scaling, cost caps, bid caps, and budget management

Good understanding of creatives, hooks, angles, offers, and buyer psychology

Reliable, proactive, and organized

Strong written English communication

Comfortable working in a fast-moving testing environment

Experience advertising in European markets

Experience with health, beauty, wellness, or problem-solving products

Experience giving creative feedback to video editors and designers

Experience managing ad accounts where many products are tested quickly



What We Offer:



Part-time role to start, with long-term potential

Fully remote work

Flexible schedule, as long as campaigns are monitored properly

A fast-moving ecommerce environment with many products and markets to test

Support from our product, funnel, creative, and campaign launching teams

Opportunity to grow into a higher-level media buying or growth role

Performance-based bonus potential after the trial period



Compensation

If you know how to identify winning ad angles, write compelling hooks, and develop high-converting creative concepts for paid social, we'd love to hear from you.



## Compensation



* **$16 USD/hour**

* Performance bonuses based on creative performance

* Long-term, full-time opportunity

* Paid time off after probation

* Develop creative briefs for video editors and designers.

* Create compelling hooks, angles, and ad concepts.

title: Instagram & Outreach Management
description:
Summary



We're a fast-growing direct-to-consumer brand in the men's self-optimisation space (fitness, grooming, looksmaxxing). You'll help us grow by finding Instagram creators to make short promo videos for our product. Those clips get used in our paid ads, so we care about creators who actually drive results, not just big follower counts.



We need one reliable person to own the front of this pipeline: find creators, make first contact, and lock in interest. Once a creator's ready to sign, I take it from there. This starts part-time with a paid trial. If you're great, it becomes a long-term, steady role.



What you'll do



You'll work inside my Instagram account to run this loop:



1. Find new Instagram creators that fit our brand and audience (this is the heart of the role)

2. Send the outreach DM to start the conversation

3. Follow up, and once they're interested, offer them a price for the video clips

4. Hand the deal over to me to finalise and contract

5. Report back regularly: who you've contacted, who's interested, and where each one stands



What we're looking for



- Excellent written English, DMs that sound natural and human, never copy-pasted

- Instagram-native, you understand how creators and short-form content actually work

- Comfortable talking numbers and offering a price politely and confidently

- Seriously organized, you live in spreadsheets and never let a follow-up slip

- A self-starter who follows a process without being chased

- Trustworthy, since you'll be working inside our account

- Reliable internet and consistent working hours



Bonus points



- Previous influencer / UGC creator outreach experience

- Familiar with UGC made for paid ads (not just organic posts)

- Genuine interest in fitness, grooming, or men's self-improvement



Details



- Type: Part-time to start (~10-15 hrs/week), with a paid trial task before we commit

- Location: 100% remote / work from home

- Long-term: Steady ongoing role for the right person, with room to grow



How to apply



Read this part carefully, most applicants won't, and that's the first thing we're testing.



1. Start your application with the word "GREENLIGHT" so we know you read this far.

2. In 2-3 sentences, tell us about any outreach or social media work you've done.

3. Include a link to ONE Instagram creator you think would be a great fit for a men's fitness or grooming brand, plus one line on why.



Applications that skip any of these three steps won't be reviewed.

title: Head of Operations
description:
Who We Are



We're building something special, and we need someone who loves the art of keeping things running smoothly. Not in a boring spreadsheet way (okay, maybe a little), but in a "let's help everyone crush their goals" kind of way.



The Role in Plain English



You'll be the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. Think of yourself as equal parts accountability partner, cheerleader, and problem-solver. Your mission? Keep department heads on track with their numbers, help them course-correct when needed, and ensure the whole team stays connected and productive.

This isn't about being the "bad cop." It's about being the person everyone can count on to help them succeed.



What You'll Actually Do



Host weekly accountability calls with department heads to review progress and celebrate wins

Track key metrics and help tea
mbers understand what their numbers mean

Create action plans when someone's struggling to hit their targets (and coach them through it)

Follow up on missed meetings and make sure recordings get to the right people

Handle the admin work that keeps our operations humming

Spot patterns before they become problems and suggest solutions

Be the go-to person when someone needs help getting unstuck



You'll Love This Job If



You get satisfaction from helping people reach their goals

Following up doesn't feel like nagging to you—it feels like caring

You're organized without being rigid

You can have tough conversations while staying human and supportive

You think spreadsheets and to-do lists are kind of beautiful

You're naturally curious about why things work (or don't work)



You Probably Won't Love This Job If



You prefer working on solo projects with minimal people interaction

You get frustrated easily when others need reminders

You find admin work soul-crushing rather than satisfying

You're looking for a creative or strategy-focused role



What We're Looking For



2+ years of experience in operations, project management, or a similar role

Track record of keeping teams accountable and improving performance

Excellent communication skills—you can be direct without being harsh

Comfort with numbers, metrics, and dashboards

Self-starter mentality (you're remote, so you'll need to drive your own day)

Coaching mindset: you genuinely want to see people succeed

If you have read the complete JD, enter the number 789 in the questionnaire; if you are a bot, enter 987.



Non-Negotiables



Fluent English: You'll be communicating with the team daily, so strong written and spoken English is essential

Camera-ready: Most of our calls are video-based—you need to be comfortable being on camera regularly

Reliable remote setup: Dedicated workspace with stable internet connection (no cutting out mid-call!)



Why Work With Us



Fully remote, ork from your home office, a cafe, or a beach (we don't judge)

Flexible schedule that respects your life outside work

Small team where your impact is visible and valued

Culture that values accountability AND empathy

Opportunity to shape how we operate as we grow

title: Creative Operations Manager - E-commerce
description:
Want to run a creative department end to end? Join us as Creative Operations Manager: full ownership of the team, the dashboard, and the output of a fast-growing e-commerce brand.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce company hiring a Creative Operations Manager to run our creative department: video editors, graphic designers, and copywriters.



You are not here to make the creative. You are here to make the creative machine run. Capacity, output, deadlines, and people.



This is a leadership role. You are trusted to own outcomes, not be micromanaged on tasks.

If you prefer a task-only execution role, this is not for you.



This role lives in the numbers. You'll own our creative dashboard entirely, and at any 
nt you'll know who has room for more work, who's overloaded, and what's at risk of slipping, before anyone asks.



You don't manage from a distance. You catch problems early, confront underperformance head-on, and make tough people decisions with confidence.



Full ownership is the goal. This role is measured by one thing: how efficiently you scale creative output without sacrificing quality.





What You’ll Own:



The Dashboard and Capacity Planning

- Own the creative ops dashboard: capacity, utilization, deadlines, and workload.

- Track output per editor and per project. Spot bottlenecks before they hit.

- Forecast production and hiring needs weekly and monthly.

- Bring leadership data-backed recommendations, not opinions.

- When a number drops, you find the leak and have a fix in place.



The Team

- Directly manage the video editing team, with copywriters in scope when needed.

- Run interviews and assess talent well. Hiring is core to this role.

- Run one-on-ones and performance reviews.

- Hold people accountable. When someone underperforms, name the problem, set a clear path with a deadline, and if they don't hit it, make the call yourself.



Process, Systems, and AI

- Audit and rebuild outdated workflows and SOPs across the creative pipeline.

- Every project has an owner, a deadline, and a status. You enforce all three.

- Use AI daily to multiply output: SOPs, data analysis, automation, reports, forecasting.

- Grow capacity without growing headcount.

- Strong with spreadsheets and automation tools.

- Keep individual contributors, managers, and leadership in sync so production never stops.





Must-Haves:

- 3+ years in operations or team management, ideally overseeing creative or production teams.

- Highly analytical and obsessed with numbers. Capacity planning, utilization, and performance metrics are your comfort zone.

- Direct communicator who doesn’t avoid conflict. You address problems head-on and don’t let issues sit.

- Comfortable making difficult people decisions, including terminations, and experienced in doing so.

- Proven experience running structured interviews and hiring.

- Data fluent. Strong in spreadsheets, and you know when to use a median over an average.

- Technical enough to work with automation tools, scripts, and developers, and to pick up new software fast.

- Heavy, hands-on use of AI in daily ops work. You can name what you use and why.

- Extremely organized and process-oriented. Nothing sits, nothing waits, and you always know who’s stuck and on what.

- Strong written and spoken English. You’ll run meetings, hold people accountable, and write SOPs.

- Daily overlap from 1 PM to 10 PM Manila time (GMT+8), and reachable when urgent issues come up.



Nice-to-Haves:

- Experience managing video editors, designers, or other creative production teams at scale.

- Experience building or owning a capacity or KPI dashboard.

- Strong experience inside ClickUp, Notion, Airtable, 
, or similar.

- Experience building AI workflows or automations.

- Basic understanding of video production workflows. You don’t need to edit, you need to know what “done” and “good” look like.



How we hire is fast and respectful of your time

1. Fill out our quick form. Simple questions, ~5 minutes.

2. We reply to every single person who applies. No ghosting.

3. Pass the first round ? a short interview to ensure culture fit

4. Past the first interview ? a short technical interview.

4. Crush it ? we send you an offer.



What you get when you go full-time (after a 1 to 2 month probation):

We genuinely take care of our team.

- Salary raise above your starting pay

- 13th-month pay

- 18 days paid time off + holidays

- Every AI tool you need, paid by us

- Health insurance

- Annual training/learning budget

- A chance to fly out and meet the rest of the team (totally optional)





We invest hard in our people. We're looking for someone who wants to build something long-term.



Apply now. It takes 5 minutes.

creative-operations-manager-e-commerce

We’re Blue Zone, a rebellious pet nutrition brand from the Netherlands on a mission to give dogs their longest, healthiest lives. We do this with our air-dried, raw-quality dog food that’s as honest as it gets. No marketing fluff. No filler. Just real food, built on truth and transparency.



Now, we’re looking for a skilled and motivated video editor to help bring our message to life across digital channels. You’ll be crafting high-converting, emotionally compelling ad creatives that tell our story in a way people actually want to watch.



Your Mission (if you choose to accept it):

You’ll be turning raw content, user-generated videos, brand video’s, and brand messaging into attention demanding content. Think short-form edits, voiceover-led explainer reels, and a whole lot of creativity in between.



We're not your average pet brand. So we don’t want average creatives. We’re growing fast, and we’re here to shake things up.



What We’re Looking For:

- Strong Editing Skills

You’re a master at Premiere Pro & After Effects and know how to turn raw footage into compelling short-form content. High-quality transitions, pacing, and storytelling are your jam.

- Quick to Learn, Quick to Adapt

We move fast, so you need to be comfortable with quick feedback loops, tools, and our systems.



- Reliable and Communicative

We don’t micromanage, but we do expect clear communication and fast delivery. If something’s unclear or blocking you, you speak up early.



- Eager to Improve

You’re open to feedback, love to grow, and aren’t precious about revisions. We’ll support your growth with editing guides and brand templates.



Must-Haves

- Fluent in English (written + spoken)

- 2+ year of video editing experience

- Tools you already use; After Effects & Premiere Pro

- Solid sense of visual design: spacing, color, contrast, hierarchy

- Comfortable using AI tools

- Minimum availability: 40 hours/week



What You’ll Get

- A long-term, remote role with a fast-growing brand

- A creative-first team where your input matters & you can make an actual impact

- Freedom to grow your role and responsibilities

- Access to ready-made assets, AI tools, and a clear process

- A company mission worth standing behind (and a few very cute dog photos)



Compensation

- Approx. $800/month full-time

- Growth opportunities as we scale



How to Apply

1. Complete the form & trial task linked below:


/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfeyjzydXLlXp8sieHSxEdVSIhCeb1WH6dnJohUN1FvzDkaBg/viewform?usp=header

2. Send your edit along with your portfolio or relevant work

3. Include the word “Bulalo” in your message, so we know you’re paying attention



We can’t wait to meet you,



Dean



CEO, Blue Zone

title: Executive Assistant / Operations Coordinator
description:
About Us:

We help wedding filmmakers and photographers grow the business side of their business (marketing, offers, funnels, systems, and sales). We’re a lean, 7-figure online coaching company. You’ll work directly with the founder.





Role Overview:

Your mission is to keep the founder’s calendar, inbox, payments, student logistics, and core tracking accurate and organized so he can focus on growing the business.



You’ll turn messy to-dos into clean checklists, keep our numbers right, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.





-----





Responsibilities:



- Manage and organize the founder’s personal and business
 inbox (Draft replies for approval, flag urgent messages immediately, clear spam).



- Own the founder’s calendar (no double bookings, open slots for appointments, confirmations sent, set appointments).



- Handle customer support: payments, refunds, disputes, membership access, double charges, simple “how do I…?” questions.



- Support our clients: Reply to basic questions using our AI assistant + internal FAQ, fix access / account permissions issues, upload videos and resources



- Update tracking sheets daily: ads, leads, calls, sales outcomes, contract amounts, cash collected.



- Prepare exports (e.g.
 lists) following clear checklists.



- Prepare upcoming payments, process payments (with approval), and follow up on failed payments using scripts.



- Assign projects to video editors and organize video/audio files and folders.



- Help maintain SOPs: update checklists when processes change and record Looms of you doing tasks.



- Occasionally help with simple one-off projects: basic dashboards in Google Sheets, designs in Canva, light research.



- Order weekly meal prep for the founder.





-----





Requirements: 



- Excellent written and spoken English.



- Experience in customer support and/or EA/VA roles is REQUIRED.



- Strong with Google Sheets (including basic formulas) is REQUIRED.



- Very detail-oriented and accurate with numbers and data entry.



- Comfortable learning new tools (Claude, Hyros, GoHighLevel, Zapier, Airtable, etc.).



- Reliable internet and webcam (video required for meetings).



 - Able to work full-time (40 hours/week) with at least 8 hours a day Pacific Standard Time zone.



- Able to start ASAP.



Nice to Have (not required)

Experience with: Online coaching programs, Airtable, GoHighLevel, Hyros, funnels,
 automations, Asana/Trello, Canva/Photoshop, basic video editing / content workflows.





-----





Do not apply if



- You are an agency or plan to subcontract work to someone else.

- You currently have another full-time job and cannot commit 40 hours/week to this role.

- You dislike detailed work, checklists, and working with numbers / spreadsheets.

- You are not comfortable following strict processes and updating SOPs.

- You are looking for a short-term gig (this is a long-term role).





-----



Compensation:



- Starting: $1,000-$1,500 USD per month depending on experience. Top performers can grow beyond this over time. We do a formal performance review at 90 days, with the opportunity for a salary increase based on results.



- Full-time (40 hours/week). Overtime only if pre-approved and paid.



- Performance-based raises and bonuses as the company grows and hits milestones.



- Commission opportunities for appointment-setting that leads to sales.



- Additional small bonuses for collecting approved client testimonials and reviews.



- Paid time off with notice.





-----



How to Apply (follow these steps exactly)



1. Complete the application form here:

https://go.weddingfilmmakermastery.com/hiring-ea 





2. Change the subject line of this to ‘I want to work for you [Founder’s name]’





3. Reply back to this with ‘Done’

If you write more than what is asked for above we will ignore your application.





-----



Hiring Process (If considered)



1. Interview with our recruiter

2. 2-3 hour paid test project

3. 2-4 week paid trial period (fully paid)

4. If we’re both happy, this becomes a long-term, full-time role.

title: Video Editor
description:
Role: AI-Powered Video Editor (Direct Response & E-commerce)

Company: Stealth 6-Figure/Month Health & Wellness Brand

Location: Remote

Compensation: Competitive / Based on Portfolio & Speed

– $700 Base + $10/video completed (Can easily make upto $1000)

About the Role:

We are an established, rapidly scaling 6-figure-a-month health and wellness e-commerce brand. Our growth is fueled entirely by cutting-edge, high-converting direct-response advertising. We move fast, test relentlessly, and lean heavily into the future of automated and AI-assisted creative production.



We are not looking for a traditional, slow-paced video editor. We are looking for an AI-enabled creative force who can merge standard video editing mastery with next-generation artificial intelligence workflows to pump out high-converting ads at scale.



IMP: Read Before Applying



Crucial Requirement: This is a hard filter. You must be an AI-enabled video editor. You will be required to use image, video, and voice generation tools to complete, iterate, and polish our video creatives. If you do not possess these skills or have no interest in mastering the AI creative stack, unfortunately, you are not the right fit for us.



What You Will Do

Produce Scroll-Stoppers: Edit high-performing Direct Response (DR) ads – Meta creatives that capture attention in the first 2 seconds.



Deploy the AI Stack: Generate realistic AI avatars, voiceovers, and create hyper-targeted B-roll assets using generative AI tools to build unique visual narratives.



Enhance Retention: Use advanced pacing, good typography, dynamic transitions, bit of sound design to keep viewers hooked through the entire video.



Your Technical Skillset

Core Editing: Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects, or CapCut Pro.



AI Generation: Deep familiarity with tools like HeyGen (for avatar generation), ElevenLabs (for voice cloning and text-to-speech), and Higgsfield (for asset and video generation).



E-com Direct Response: An understanding of consumer psychology, framing, pacing, and what makes a video convert into sales (not just look pretty).



Portfolio Requirements

To be considered, your portfolio must explicitly showcase:



Live E-com Ads: Proven examples of direct-response or user-generated content (UGC) style ads that you have edited.



AI Execution: Clear examples of how you have integrated AI tools (specifically realistic AI avatars, voice synthesis, or AI-generated visual environments) into a finished ad project.



Work Schedule & Availability

6-Day Work Week: This is a fast-paced role requiring consistent output from Monday through Saturday.



Sunday Off (With Flexibility): Sunday is your standard designated day off. However, because we run a high-volume e-commerce operation, you must be flexible. If there is a critical campaign launch, an urgent asset optimization, or a high-priority pivot, we may require you to jump in and work on a Sunday. (very rare but still)

Examples of what we are looking for:

If the work is on time and good. You can get a decent promotion really quickly.



CRUCIAL: Paid Trial Task



Do not apply if you are not ready to complete a small trial task. If your portfolio is strong and hits our benchmarks, you will be fully compensated for this trial. It will be a brief, targeted 10-to-20-second creative task to test your workflow alignment, speed, and AI tool execution.

title: Instagram Account Manager – Remote, Part-Time
description:

We're the opposite, and we built our whole system around it.



Every task you'll do is written down in a step-by-step SOP. Every question has a place to be asked. Every action gets logged in a tracker, so there's never a debate about what was done. You'll always know exactly what's expected of you – and if something is unclear, that's on us to fix, not on you to guess.

- Daily posting of Reels and Stories on assigned Instagram accounts

- Following our SOP exactly as written – no improvising needed or wanted

- Logging every action in the tracker

- Communicating with the team in chat during your working hours



Who this fits:

- You've done VA or online work before and you value clear processes

- You'd rather follow a good system than invent your own

- You're precise. You notice when step 4 comes before step 3

- You want one stable, long-term client instead of juggling five unreliable ones



Requirements:

- iPhone (mandatory)

- Stable internet and reliable power

- Written English strong enough for SOPs and team chat

- 20 hours/week, consistently



Pay:

$2–3/hour to start, with a bonus system for clean, mistake-free work. Our longest-standing tea
mbers handle more accounts at noticeably higher rates. We keep people who are reliable – and we pay them accordingly.



How to apply:

Send a message with exactly these three things, in this order:



1. Your weekly availability (days and hours, your local time)

2. One sentence: describe the most organized client or employer you've worked with – what made them good?

3. The very last line of your message must be: Blue Horizon

title: Reliable Instagram Poster – Remote, Part-Time, Long-Term
description:
Before anything else: this post is long on purpose. We want people who read the whole thing. If that already sounds like too much, we're probably not a fit – and no hard feelings.



We run several Instagram accounts and we're adding two or three people to the team. We're not looking for the most talented person who applies. We're looking for the most reliable one. There's a difference, and it matters to us.



Here's the honest version of the job:

You'll do the same things every day. Post Reels and Stories, interact with accounts, log what you did, check in with the team. It's not exciting. It's not creative. It's a routine you repeat correctly, day after day, whether or not anyone is watching. Some people quietly hate that kind of work. Some people are wired for it and feel calm doing it well. We're only looking for the second kind.



Be honest with yourself – do these describe you?

- When someone gives you a checklist, you actually use it

- You notice small things other people skip

- You'd rather ask one question than make one wrong guess

- You finish what you start, even the boring parts

- You're looking for something steady, not something for a few weeks



If you read those and thought "yes, that's me," we'd genuinely like to hear from you. If you had to talk yourself into a few of them, please save us both the time.



The day-to-day:

- Post Reels and Stories on assigned accounts every day

- Interact naturally with accounts (likes, follows, comments, story replies)

- Follow our SOP exactly – we've refined it and it works

- Log every action in our tracker

- Stay reachable in the team chat during your working hours



What you'll need:

- An iPhone (required, not negotiable)

- Stable internet and reliable power

- Written English good enough to read instructions and reply clearly (your spoken English doesn't need to be perfect)

- Real attention to detail – this is what we filter hardest for



No prior Instagram experience required. If you're reliable and you learn fast, we'll train you. The one thing we can't train is whether you take the work seriously – that part is on you.



What we offer:

- Proper training and a team that answers your questions

- $2–3/hour to start, around 20 hours per week

- A clear bonus system for clean, consistent work

- Real growth – our best people now handle more accounts at noticeably higher pay, and they all started where you'd start

- Flexible hours, as long as your reliability and communication stay solid



To apply:

Send us a message with these three things, in this exact order:



1. Your weekly availability (days and hours, in your local time)

2. One sentence: tell us about a time being careful actually mattered

3. Make the very last line of your message: Blue Horizon



If any of the three is missing or out of order, we won't read it. The application is the first part of the job – following the steps is how it begins.
